# Praseodymium — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the chemical symbol for Praseodymium?", "Pr"),
    ("Who discovered Praseodymium?", "Carl Auer von Welsbach"),
    ("What is symbol?", "Pr"),
    ("What is atomic number?", "59"),
    ("What is atomic mass?", "140.91 u"),
    ("What is group?", "—"),
    ("What is period?", "6"),

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
